name: Goblin Signs (Abbey of the Golden Sparrow)
body:
Your time on the mountain protecting both the abbey and merchant travelers has helped you become familiar with the way of goblinoids and the signs they leave behind.

Benefit: You gain a +2 trait bonus to Initiative checks when goblins or other goblinoid creatures are present and that you are aware of.
